zh.title: 对数项在无穷远的抵消
zh.prompt: 计算 $\displaystyle \int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(x+1)}$。

knowledge: 无穷区间反常积分的定义
solution.analysis: 先作部分分式 $\frac1{x(x+1)}=\frac1x-\frac1{x+1}$；两个对数必须作为整体取极限。
pitfalls: 把无穷大直接当作可代入端点
双侧无穷积分未拆成两个独立极限
对称主值冒充普通收敛
solution.verification: 因 $0<\frac1{x(x+1)}<\frac1{x^2}$ 对 $x\ge1$ 成立，积分应收敛且小于 $1$；$0<\ln2<1$。
solution.takeaway: 无穷端点必须先截断再取极限；双侧积分要求左右两部分分别收敛。
solution.extension: 改变截断方式并检查结果是否稳定，可揭示主值与普通反常积分的差异。

en.title: Cancellation of Logarithms at Infinity
en.prompt: Evaluate $\displaystyle \int_1^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(x+1)}$.

solution.analysis: First decompose $\frac1{x(x+1)}=\frac1x-\frac1{x+1}$; the logarithms must be combined before taking the limit.
steps: As $R\to+\infty$, $\frac{R}{R+1}\to1$, so the first term tends to $0$.
pitfalls: substituting infinity as if it were an endpoint
failing to split a two-sided infinite interval into independent limits
confusing a symmetric principal value with ordinary convergence
solution.verification: Since $0<\frac1{x(x+1)}<\frac1{x^2}$ for $x\ge1$, the integral must converge and be below $1$; indeed $0<\ln2<1$.
solution.takeaway: An infinite endpoint must be truncated before taking a limit, and a two-sided integral requires both one-sided pieces to converge independently.
solution.extension: Vary the truncation scheme to expose the difference between a principal value and an ordinary improper integral.

zh.title: 反常积分的 Cauchy 尾部准则
zh.prompt: 设 $f$ 在每个有限区间 $[a,R]$ 上连续。证明 $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ 收敛，当且仅当对任意 $\varepsilon>0$，存在 $M>a$，使所有 $B>A\ge M$ 都满足 $\displaystyle \left|\int_A^Bf(x)\,dx\right|<\varepsilon$。

solution.analysis: 把截断积分记为 $F(R)=\int_a^Rf$；题设条件正是实数函数 $F(R)$ 在 $R\to+\infty$ 时的 Cauchy 条件。
steps: 若反常积分收敛到 $L$，取 $M$ 使 $R\ge M$ 时 $|F(R)-L|<\frac\varepsilon2$。
反之，尾部条件说明 $F(R)$ 在 $R\to+\infty$ 时满足 Cauchy 条件。
实数完备性保证存在有限极限 $L=\lim_{R\to+\infty}F(R)$。
按反常积分定义，这正说明 $\int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ 收敛。
pitfalls: 比较不等式方向用反
极限比较常数取到 $0$ 或无穷仍直接套等价结论
只证收敛而未检查绝对收敛
solution.verification: 对 $f(x)=x^{-2}$，尾积分绝对值为 $\frac1A-\frac1B<\frac1A$；取 $M>\frac1\varepsilon$ 即满足准则。
solution.takeaway: 审敛比较必须同时说明非负性、比较区间和已知基准积分。
solution.extension: 尝试用同一基准函数分别构造上界与下界，理解充分条件与必要条件的方向。

en.title: The Cauchy Tail Criterion for an Improper Integral
en.prompt: Let $f$ be continuous on every finite interval $[a,R]$. Prove that $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ converges if and only if, for every $\varepsilon>0$, there exists $M>a$ such that all $B>A\ge M$ satisfy $\displaystyle \left|\int_A^Bf(x)\,dx\right|<\varepsilon$.

solution.analysis: Let $F(R)=\int_a^Rf$; the stated tail condition is exactly the Cauchy condition for the real-valued function $F(R)$ as $R\to+\infty$.
steps: If the improper integral converges to $L$, choose $M$ so that $|F(R)-L|<\frac\varepsilon2$ whenever $R\ge M$.
Conversely, the tail condition says that $F(R)$ satisfies the Cauchy condition as $R\to+\infty$.
Completeness of the real numbers gives a finite limit $L=\lim_{R\to+\infty}F(R)$.
By definition, this is convergence of $\int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$.
pitfalls: reversing the comparison inequality
using the finite-positive limit conclusion when the ratio tends to zero or infinity
proving convergence without checking absolute convergence
solution.verification: For $f(x)=x^{-2}$, the tail has magnitude $\frac1A-\frac1B<\frac1A$; choosing $M>\frac1\varepsilon$ verifies the criterion.
solution.takeaway: A convergence comparison must state nonnegativity, the tail or neighborhood being compared, and the benchmark integral.
solution.extension: Use the same benchmark to build both upper and lower comparisons and clarify the direction of sufficient and necessary conditions.

zh.title: 双侧无穷积分的独立拆分
zh.prompt: 按普通反常积分定义计算 $\displaystyle \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}$。

knowledge: 无穷区间反常积分的定义
solution.analysis: 普通双侧积分必须在任意有限分点（取 $0$）拆成两个独立极限；本题两侧都收敛。
steps: 两部分分别有有限极限，因此普通反常积分收敛。
pitfalls: 把无穷大直接当作可代入端点
双侧无穷积分未拆成两个独立极限
对称主值冒充普通收敛
solution.verification: 被积函数为偶函数，可写成 $2\int_0^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}=2\cdot\frac\pi2=\pi$；这与独立拆分一致。
solution.takeaway: 无穷端点必须先截断再取极限；双侧积分要求左右两部分分别收敛。
solution.extension: 改变截断方式并检查结果是否稳定，可揭示主值与普通反常积分的差异。

en.title: Independent Splitting of a Two-sided Infinite Integral
en.prompt: Using the ordinary improper-integral definition, evaluate $\displaystyle \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}$.

solution.analysis: An ordinary two-sided integral must be split at a finite point, here $0$, into two independent limits; both pieces converge.
steps: Both pieces have finite limits, so the ordinary improper integral converges.
pitfalls: substituting infinity as if it were an endpoint
failing to split a two-sided infinite interval into independent limits
confusing a symmetric principal value with ordinary convergence
solution.verification: The integrand is even, so the value is $2\int_0^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}=2\cdot\frac\pi2=\pi$, consistent with the independent split.
solution.takeaway: An infinite endpoint must be truncated before taking a limit, and a two-sided integral requires both one-sided pieces to converge independently.
solution.extension: Vary the truncation scheme to expose the difference between a principal value and an ordinary improper integral.

en.title: Misusing Symmetry as Ordinary Convergence
en.prompt: A student argues that $\frac{x}{1+x^2}$ is odd and therefore $\displaystyle \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\frac{x}{1+x^2}\,dx=0$. Diagnose the error and determine the ordinary integral and symmetric principal value.

solution.analysis: Oddness controls symmetric truncations but does not guarantee finite independent limits on the two infinite tails.
steps: Ordinary convergence requires both pieces to have finite limits, so the integral diverges.
Every symmetric truncation is $0$ by oddness, so the principal value is $0$.
pitfalls: substituting infinity as if it were an endpoint
failing to split a two-sided infinite interval into independent limits

zh.title: 对数函数的可积奇性
zh.prompt: 计算 $\displaystyle \int_0^1\ln x\,dx$。

knowledge: 瑕点在端点的反常积分
幂函数与对数型端点行为
solution.analysis: $\ln x$ 在 $0$ 处趋于 $-\infty$，但其原函数中的乘积 $x\ln x$ 有有限右极限。
steps: 分部积分得到原函数 $x\ln x-x$。
所以反常积分收敛，值为 $-1$。
pitfalls: 直接把瑕点代入原函数
忽略极限方向

solution.extension: 把被积函数与 $x^{-p}$ 或 $|\ln x|$ 比较，可快速判断附近的可积性。

en.title: The Integrable Logarithmic Singularity
en.prompt: Evaluate $\displaystyle \int_0^1\ln x\,dx$.

solution.analysis: $\ln x$ tends to $-\infty$ at $0$, but the product $x\ln x$ in its antiderivative has a finite right limit.
steps: Integration by parts gives the antiderivative $x\ln x-x$.
Thus the improper integral converges to $-1$.
pitfalls: substituting the singular endpoint directly
ignoring the direction of the limit
judging from an antiderivative without evaluating the truncation limit
solution.verification: The substitution $x=e^{-t}$ gives $-\int_0^{+\infty}te^{-t}dt=-1$, providing an independent check.
solution.takeaway: Both the value and convergence of an endpoint-singular integral are determined by its one-sided truncation limit.
solution.extension: Comparison with $x^{-p}$ or $|\ln x|$ often reveals local integrability near the endpoint.

zh.title: 同时含零端与无穷端的换元
zh.prompt: 计算 $\displaystyle \int_0^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{(1+x)\sqrt{x}}$。

knowledge: 无穷区间反常积分的定义
solution.analysis: 该积分在 $0$ 处有可积根式奇性且区间无穷；令 $x=t^2$ 可同时消去根号并保留两个反常端点。
pitfalls: 把无穷大直接当作可代入端点
双侧无穷积分未拆成两个独立极限
对称主值冒充普通收敛
solution.verification: 在 $0$ 附近被积函数与 $x^{-\frac12}$ 同阶，在无穷远与 $x^{-\frac32}$ 同阶；两端均满足幂积分收敛条件。
solution.takeaway: 无穷端点必须先截断再取极限；双侧积分要求左右两部分分别收敛。
solution.extension: 改变截断方式并检查结果是否稳定，可揭示主值与普通反常积分的差异。

en.title: A Substitution with Both Zero and Infinite Endpoints
en.prompt: Evaluate $\displaystyle \int_0^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{(1+x)\sqrt{x}}$.

solution.analysis: The integral has an integrable square-root singularity at $0$ and an infinite interval; $x=t^2$ removes the radical while preserving both improper endpoints.
pitfalls: substituting infinity as if it were an endpoint
failing to split a two-sided infinite interval into independent limits
confusing a symmetric principal value with ordinary convergence
solution.verification: Near $0$ the integrand is comparable to $x^{-\frac12}$, and at infinity to $x^{-\frac32}$; both endpoints meet the power-integral convergence conditions.
solution.takeaway: An infinite endpoint must be truncated before taking a limit, and a two-sided integral requires both one-sided pieces to converge independently.
solution.extension: Vary the truncation scheme to expose the difference between a principal value and an ordinary improper integral.

zh.title: 非负函数比较审敛法
zh.prompt: 设 $0\le f(x)\le g(x)$ 对所有 $x\ge a$ 成立，且两函数在有限区间上可积。证明：若 $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}g(x)\,dx$ 收敛，则 $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ 收敛；若 $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ 发散，则 $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}g(x)\,dx$ 发散。

solution.analysis: 非负性使截断积分随上限单调增加；上比较给出有界性，而“发散小函数推出大发散”是同一命题的逆否形式。
steps: 由 $0\le f\le g$，对每个 $R>a$ 有 $0\le F(R)\le G(R)$。
若 $\int_a^{+\infty}g$ 收敛，则 $G(R)$ 有有限上界；于是单调递增的 $F(R)$ 也有上界。
单调有界原理给出 $F(R)$ 的有限极限，因此 $\int_a^{+\infty}f$ 收敛。
第二个结论取逆否：若 $\int_a^{+\infty}g$ 收敛，第一部分迫使 $\int_a^{+\infty}f$ 收敛；故 $f$ 发散时 $g$ 不可能收敛。
pitfalls: 比较不等式方向用反
极限比较常数取到 $0$ 或无穷仍直接套等价结论
只证收敛而未检查绝对收敛
solution.verification: 以 $f(x)=\frac1{x^2+x}$、$g(x)=\frac1{x^2}$ 为例，$0<f<g$ 且大积分收敛，故小积分也收敛。
solution.takeaway: 审敛比较必须同时说明非负性、比较区间和已知基准积分。
solution.extension: 尝试用同一基准函数分别构造上界与下界，理解充分条件与必要条件的方向。

en.title: The Comparison Test for Nonnegative Functions
en.prompt: Assume $0\le f(x)\le g(x)$ for all $x\ge a$, with both functions integrable on finite intervals. Prove: if $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}g(x)\,dx$ converges, then $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ converges; if $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ diverges, then $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}g(x)\,dx$ diverges.

solution.analysis: Nonnegativity makes truncated integrals monotone in the upper limit; the upper comparison supplies boundedness, and the divergence statement is the contrapositive.
steps: From $0\le f\le g$, we have $0\le F(R)\le G(R)$ for every $R>a$.
If $\int_a^{+\infty}g$ converges, then $G(R)$ is bounded; hence the increasing function $F(R)$ is also bounded.
Monotone bounded convergence gives a finite limit for $F(R)$, so $\int_a^{+\infty}f$ converges.
The second claim is the contrapositive: convergence of the larger integral would force convergence of the smaller, so divergence of the smaller forces divergence of the larger.
pitfalls: reversing the comparison inequality
using the finite-positive limit conclusion when the ratio tends to zero or infinity
proving convergence without checking absolute convergence
solution.verification: For example, $f(x)=\frac1{x^2+x}$ and $g(x)=\frac1{x^2}$ satisfy $0<f<g$, and convergence of the larger integral forces convergence of the smaller.
solution.takeaway: A convergence comparison must state nonnegativity, the tail or neighborhood being compared, and the benchmark integral.
solution.extension: Use the same benchmark to build both upper and lower comparisons and clarify the direction of sufficient and necessary conditions.

zh.title: 带参数正二次式的无穷积分
zh.prompt: 设 $a>0$。计算 $\displaystyle I(a)=\int_0^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^2+2ax+2a^2}$。

knowledge: 无穷区间反常积分的定义
solution.analysis: 先配方为 $(x+a)^2+a^2$；$a>0$ 保证尺度换元方向与正的反正切尺度因子。
pitfalls: 把无穷大直接当作可代入端点
双侧无穷积分未拆成两个独立极限
对称主值冒充普通收敛
solution.verification: 直接令 $x=at$ 可见积分应按 $a^{-1}$ 缩放；闭式 $\frac\pi{4a}$ 与该量纲完全一致。
solution.takeaway: 无穷端点必须先截断再取极限；双侧积分要求左右两部分分别收敛。
solution.extension: 改变截断方式并检查结果是否稳定，可揭示主值与普通反常积分的差异。

en.title: An Infinite Integral with a Parameterized Positive Quadratic
en.prompt: Let $a>0$. Evaluate $\displaystyle I(a)=\int_0^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x^2+2ax+2a^2}$.

solution.analysis: Complete the square as $(x+a)^2+a^2$; $a>0$ fixes the orientation and the positive arctangent scale factor.
pitfalls: substituting infinity as if it were an endpoint
failing to split a two-sided infinite interval into independent limits
confusing a symmetric principal value with ordinary convergence
solution.verification: The direct scaling $x=at$ shows that the integral must scale as $a^{-1}$; $\frac\pi{4a}$ has exactly this dependence.
solution.takeaway: An infinite endpoint must be truncated before taking a limit, and a two-sided integral requires both one-sided pieces to converge independently.

zh.title: 跨越二阶瑕点套公式的错误
zh.prompt: 某同学写 $\displaystyle \int_0^2\frac{dx}{(x-1)^2}=\left.-\frac1{x-1}\right|_0^2=-2$。指出全部错误并给出正确结论。
zh.answer: 普通反常积分发散到 $+\infty$；不能跨越 $x=1$ 直接使用 Newton-Leibniz 公式。

knowledge: 左右反常积分独立收敛
Cauchy 主值与普通积分的区别
solution.analysis: 被积函数在内部点 $1$ 无定义且始终非负；负答案已构成警报，必须把区间拆开并取两个单侧极限。
steps: 在 $x=1$ 处分母为零，因此原积分是内部瑕积分。
任一侧发散已足够说明普通反常积分发散；两侧都为正无穷，更不能得到负值。
pitfalls: 跨越瑕点直接套 Newton-Leibniz 公式
用正负无穷抵消
把对称截断极限当成普通积分
solution.verification: 由于被积函数在其定义域内非负，任何截断积分都非负；原计算得到 $-2$ 已违反最基本的符号检查。
solution.takeaway: 内部瑕点必须把区间切开；任一侧发散，普通反常积分就发散。
solution.extension: 若对称主值存在，应单独标记为 $\operatorname{PV}$，不能省略限定词。

en.title: Applying Newton-Leibniz across a Second-order Singularity
en.prompt: A student writes $\displaystyle \int_0^2\frac{dx}{(x-1)^2}=\left.-\frac1{x-1}\right|_0^2=-2$. Identify all errors and give the correct conclusion.
en.answer: The ordinary improper integral diverges to $+\infty$; Newton-Leibniz cannot be applied across $x=1$.

knowledge: Cauchy principal value versus ordinary convergence
solution.analysis: The integrand is undefined at the interior point $1$ and is nonnegative; the negative result is already a warning, and the interval must be split into two one-sided limits.
steps: The denominator vanishes at $x=1$, so this is an improper integral with an interior singularity.
Here $-\frac1{c-1}\to+\infty$, so the left part diverges.
The right part is $\int_1^2\frac{dx}{(x-1)^2}=\lim_{d\to1^+}\left[-\frac1{x-1}\right]_d^2$, which also tends to $+\infty$.
Divergence on either side is enough; both are positive infinite, so a negative value is impossible.
pitfalls: applying Newton-Leibniz across a singularity
canceling positive and negative infinities
reporting a symmetric truncation limit as the ordinary integral
solution.verification: Because the integrand is nonnegative wherever defined, every truncated integral is nonnegative; the value $-2$ fails the most basic sign check.
solution.takeaway: An interior singularity splits the interval; divergence on either side makes the ordinary improper integral divergent.
solution.extension: If a symmetric principal value exists, label it explicitly as $\operatorname{PV}$ rather than omitting the qualifier.

zh.title: 代数衰减与换元
zh.prompt: 计算 $\displaystyle \int_0^{+\infty}\frac{x}{(1+x^2)^{\frac32}}\,dx$。

knowledge: 无穷区间反常积分的定义
solution.analysis: 令 $u=1+x^2$ 后得到标准尾部幂积分 $u^{-\frac32}$；指数小于 $-1$，故在无穷远收敛。
steps: 令 $R\to+\infty$，第二项趋于 $0$，故结果为 $1$。
pitfalls: 把无穷大直接当作可代入端点
双侧无穷积分未拆成两个独立极限
对称主值冒充普通收敛
solution.verification: 原函数为 $-\frac1{\sqrt{1+x^2}}$；从 $0$ 到无穷的端点差为 $0-(-1)=1$。
solution.takeaway: 无穷端点必须先截断再取极限；双侧积分要求左右两部分分别收敛。
solution.extension: 改变截断方式并检查结果是否稳定，可揭示主值与普通反常积分的差异。

en.title: Algebraic Decay and Substitution
en.prompt: Evaluate $\displaystyle \int_0^{+\infty}\frac{x}{(1+x^2)^{\frac32}}\,dx$.

solution.analysis: With $u=1+x^2$, the problem becomes the standard tail integral $u^{-\frac32}$; the exponent is below $-1$, so it converges at infinity.
steps: Set $u=1+x^2$, so $du=2x\,dx$ and the endpoints become $1$ and $1+R^2$.
As $R\to+\infty$, the second term tends to $0$, so the answer is $1$.
pitfalls: substituting infinity as if it were an endpoint
failing to split a two-sided infinite interval into independent limits
confusing a symmetric principal value with ordinary convergence
solution.verification: An antiderivative is $-\frac1{\sqrt{1+x^2}}$; its endpoint difference from $0$ to infinity is $0-(-1)=1$.
solution.takeaway: An infinite endpoint must be truncated before taking a limit, and a two-sided integral requires both one-sided pieces to converge independently.
solution.extension: Vary the truncation scheme to expose the difference between a principal value and an ordinary improper integral.

zh.title: 无穷远与零点的倒数换元
zh.prompt: 设 $f$ 在 $[1,+\infty)$ 上连续。证明在任一侧收敛时，$\displaystyle \int_1^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=\int_0^1\frac{f\!\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)}{t^2}\,dt$，并说明两侧同时收敛或同时发散。

knowledge: 无穷区间反常积分的定义
solution.analysis: 先在有限截断区间 $[1,R]$ 上作 $x=\frac{1}{t}$；无穷上限对应新的瑕点 $t=0^+$，再比较完全相同的截断极限。
steps: 左右截断表达式逐项相等，所以一侧有有限极限当且仅当另一侧有有限极限。
在收敛时取极限，即得题设等式。
pitfalls: 把无穷大直接当作可代入端点
双侧无穷积分未拆成两个独立极限
对称主值冒充普通收敛
solution.verification: 取 $f(x)=x^{-p}$，右侧变为 $\int_0^1t^{p-2}dt$；其条件 $p-2>-1$ 即 $p>1$，与无穷区间幂积分准则一致。
solution.takeaway: 无穷端点必须先截断再取极限；双侧积分要求左右两部分分别收敛。
solution.extension: 改变截断方式并检查结果是否稳定，可揭示主值与普通反常积分的差异。

en.title: Reciprocal Substitution between Infinity and Zero
en.prompt: Let $f$ be continuous on $[1,+\infty)$. Prove that whenever either side converges, $\displaystyle \int_1^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=\int_0^1\frac{f\!\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)}{t^2}\,dt$, and show that the two sides converge or diverge together.

solution.analysis: First substitute $x=\frac{1}{t}$ on the finite interval $[1,R]$; the infinite endpoint becomes the new singular endpoint $t=0^+$, and the two truncated limits are identical.
steps: The truncated expressions are identical, so one has a finite limit exactly when the other does.
Taking that limit in the convergent case proves the identity.
pitfalls: substituting infinity as if it were an endpoint
failing to split a two-sided infinite interval into independent limits
confusing a symmetric principal value with ordinary convergence
solution.verification: For $f(x)=x^{-p}$, the right side becomes $\int_0^1t^{p-2}dt$, which requires $p-2>-1$, namely $p>1$, matching the infinite-interval power test.
solution.takeaway: An infinite endpoint must be truncated before taking a limit, and a two-sided integral requires both one-sided pieces to converge independently.
solution.extension: Vary the truncation scheme to expose the difference between a principal value and an ordinary improper integral.

zh.title: 零端点的幂积分全参数分类
zh.prompt: 对实参数 $p$，讨论并计算 $\displaystyle I(p)=\int_0^1\frac{dx}{x^p}$。
zh.answer: 当且仅当 $p<1$ 时收敛，且 $I(p)=\frac1{1-p}$；$p\ge1$ 时发散。

solution.analysis: 端点 $0$ 的幂指数为 $-p$；分别处理 $p=1$ 的对数临界情形和 $p\ne1$ 的幂原函数。
steps: 当 $p<1$ 时 $1-p>0$，故 $\varepsilon^{1-p}\to0$，积分收敛到 $\frac1{1-p}$。
当 $p>1$ 时 $1-p<0$，$\varepsilon^{1-p}\to+\infty$，截断积分发散到 $+\infty$。
pitfalls: 比较不等式方向用反
极限比较常数取到 $0$ 或无穷仍直接套等价结论
只证收敛而未检查绝对收敛
solution.verification: 取 $p=\frac12$ 得值 $2$，与 Q073 一致；取 $p=1$ 得对数发散，核验临界点。
solution.takeaway: 审敛比较必须同时说明非负性、比较区间和已知基准积分。
solution.extension: 尝试用同一基准函数分别构造上界与下界，理解充分条件与必要条件的方向。

en.title: Complete Parameter Classification for an Endpoint Power Integral
en.prompt: For real $p$, determine convergence and evaluate $\displaystyle I(p)=\int_0^1\frac{dx}{x^p}$.
en.answer: It converges exactly for $p<1$, with $I(p)=\frac1{1-p}$; it diverges for $p\ge1$.

solution.analysis: The power near $0$ is $-p$; treat the logarithmic boundary case $p=1$ separately from the power antiderivative for $p\ne1$.
steps: If $p>1$, then $1-p<0$ and $\varepsilon^{1-p}\to+\infty$, so the integral diverges to $+\infty$.
Thus the convergence condition is exactly $p<1$.
pitfalls: reversing the comparison inequality
using the finite-positive limit conclusion when the ratio tends to zero or infinity
proving convergence without checking absolute convergence
solution.verification: For $p=\frac12$ the value is $2$, agreeing with Q073; $p=1$ gives logarithmic divergence, checking the threshold.
solution.takeaway: A convergence comparison must state nonnegativity, the tail or neighborhood being compared, and the benchmark integral.
solution.extension: Use the same benchmark to build both upper and lower comparisons and clarify the direction of sufficient and necessary conditions.

zh.title: 极限比较审敛法
zh.prompt: 设正函数 $f,g$ 在每个有限区间 $[a,R]$ 上可积，且 $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to+\infty}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}=L$，其中 $0<L<+\infty$。证明 $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ 与 $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}g(x)\,dx$ 同敛散。

solution.analysis: 用极限定义把比值夹在两个正的常数之间，从而在充分大的尾部得到双向比较；有限首段不影响反常积分敛散。
steps: 取 $\varepsilon=\frac L2$。由极限定义，存在 $M\ge a$，使 $x\ge M$ 时 $\left|\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}-L\right|<\frac L2$。
若 $\int_a^{+\infty}g$ 收敛，则其尾部收敛，由上界比较知 $\int_M^{+\infty}f$ 收敛。
若 $\int_a^{+\infty}f$ 收敛，则由 $g(x)<\frac2L f(x)$ 得 $\int_M^{+\infty}g$ 收敛。
两函数在 $[a,M]$ 上的积分都是有限数，不改变尾部敛散性。
故两个反常积分同敛散。
pitfalls: 比较不等式方向用反
极限比较常数取到 $0$ 或无穷仍直接套等价结论
只证收敛而未检查绝对收敛
solution.verification: 对 $f(x)=\frac1{x^2+1}$、$g(x)=\frac1{x^2}$，比值趋于 $1$；二者确实都在 $[1,+\infty)$ 上收敛。
solution.takeaway: 审敛比较必须同时说明非负性、比较区间和已知基准积分。
solution.extension: 尝试用同一基准函数分别构造上界与下界，理解充分条件与必要条件的方向。

en.title: The Limit Comparison Test
en.prompt: Let positive functions $f,g$ be integrable on every finite interval $[a,R]$, and suppose $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to+\infty}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}=L$ with $0<L<+\infty$. Prove that $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ and $\displaystyle \int_a^{+\infty}g(x)\,dx$ have the same convergence behavior.

solution.analysis: Use the limit definition to trap the ratio between two positive constants, producing two-sided tail comparisons; a finite initial segment does not affect convergence.
steps: Take $\varepsilon=\frac L2$. The limit definition gives $M\ge a$ such that $\left|\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}-L\right|<\frac L2$ for $x\ge M$.
If $\int_a^{+\infty}g$ converges, its tail converges, and the upper comparison makes $\int_M^{+\infty}f$ converge.
If $\int_a^{+\infty}f$ converges, then $g(x)<\frac2L f(x)$ makes $\int_M^{+\infty}g$ converge.
Both integrals over the finite interval $[a,M]$ are finite and do not affect tail convergence.
Therefore the two improper integrals converge or diverge together.
pitfalls: reversing the comparison inequality
using the finite-positive limit conclusion when the ratio tends to zero or infinity
proving convergence without checking absolute convergence
solution.verification: For $f(x)=\frac1{x^2+1}$ and $g(x)=\frac1{x^2}$, the ratio tends to $1$, and both integrals converge on $[1,+\infty)$.
solution.takeaway: A convergence comparison must state nonnegativity, the tail or neighborhood being compared, and the benchmark integral.
solution.extension: Use the same benchmark to build both upper and lower comparisons and clarify the direction of sufficient and necessary conditions.

zh.title: 对数修正幂积分
zh.prompt: 对实参数 $p$，讨论并计算 $\displaystyle J(p)=\int_e^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(\ln x)^p}$。
zh.answer: 当且仅当 $p>1$ 时收敛，且 $J(p)=\frac1{p-1}$；$p\le1$ 时发散。

solution.analysis: 换元 $u=\ln x$ 把对数修正积分精确化为无穷区间幂积分，原下限 $e$ 变成 $1$。
steps: 端点变为 $x=e\Rightarrow u=1$，$x=R\Rightarrow u=\ln R$。
由无穷区间幂积分准则，恰在 $p>1$ 时收敛，值为 $\frac1{p-1}$。
pitfalls: 比较不等式方向用反
极限比较常数取到 $0$ 或无穷仍直接套等价结论
只证收敛而未检查绝对收敛
solution.verification: 取 $p=2$ 时原函数为 $-\frac1{\ln x}$，从 $e$ 到无穷的端点差为 $0-(-1)=1$，与公式一致。
solution.takeaway: 审敛比较必须同时说明非负性、比较区间和已知基准积分。
solution.extension: 尝试用同一基准函数分别构造上界与下界，理解充分条件与必要条件的方向。

en.title: A Logarithmically Corrected Power Integral
en.prompt: For real $p$, determine convergence and evaluate $\displaystyle J(p)=\int_e^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x(\ln x)^p}$.
en.answer: It converges exactly for $p>1$, with $J(p)=\frac1{p-1}$; it diverges for $p\le1$.

solution.analysis: The substitution $u=\ln x$ converts the logarithmically corrected integral exactly into a power integral on an infinite interval, with lower limit $1$.
steps: The endpoints become $x=e\Rightarrow u=1$ and $x=R\Rightarrow u=\ln R$.
The infinite-interval power test gives convergence exactly for $p>1$, with value $\frac1{p-1}$.
pitfalls: reversing the comparison inequality
using the finite-positive limit conclusion when the ratio tends to zero or infinity
proving convergence without checking absolute convergence
solution.verification: For $p=2$, an antiderivative is $-\frac1{\ln x}$, whose endpoint difference from $e$ to infinity is $0-(-1)=1$, agreeing with the formula.
solution.takeaway: A convergence comparison must state nonnegativity, the tail or neighborhood being compared, and the benchmark integral.
solution.extension: Use the same benchmark to build both upper and lower comparisons and clarify the direction of sufficient and necessary conditions.

zh.title: 振荡积分的条件收敛
zh.prompt: 证明 $\displaystyle \int_1^{+\infty}\frac{\sin x}{x}\,dx$ 收敛但不绝对收敛。

solution.analysis: 普通收敛用分部积分控制任意尾积分；绝对值积分则在每个正弦远离零的子区间上给出调和级数型下界。
steps: 对 $B>A\ge1$，分部积分得 $\int_A^B\frac{\sin x}{x}dx=\left.-\frac{\cos x}{x}\right|_A^B-\int_A^B\frac{\cos x}{x^2}dx$。
因此尾积分绝对值不超过 $\frac1A+\frac1B+\int_A^B\frac{dx}{x^2}<\frac3A$。
当 $A\to+\infty$ 时该上界趋于 $0$，由 Cauchy 尾部准则，原积分收敛。
对整数 $k\ge1$，在区间 $[k\pi+\frac\pi6,k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{6}]$ 上有 $|\sin x|\ge\frac12$。
该区间上的绝对值积分至少为 $\frac12\cdot\frac{2\pi}{3}\cdot\frac{1}{(k+1)\pi}=\frac1{3(k+1)}$。
这些互不相交区间的下界之和是发散的调和级数尾部，所以 $\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{|\sin x|}{x}dx$ 发散。
pitfalls: 比较不等式方向用反
极限比较常数取到 $0$ 或无穷仍直接套等价结论
只证收敛而未检查绝对收敛

en.title: Conditional Convergence of an Oscillatory Integral
